description:
Improve error messages across cloud platform adapters with actionable context.

Current issues:
- Generic "Query failed" errors without diagnosis hints
- Network errors don't suggest common causes
- Authentication failures lack credential verification steps
- Quota/limit errors not clearly identified

Goal: Wrap common exceptions with context that helps users
diagnose and fix issues without searching external docs.

Platforms to improve:
- BigQuery (quota, auth, project errors)
- Redshift (security group, cluster state, IAM)
- Snowflake (warehouse suspend, role permissions)
- Databricks (cluster state, token expiry)
